In standard supply order processing, if a return is not itemized, it is typically applied to the most recent addition or requires clarification. Given the ambiguity and the fact that no specific item was targeted for the reduction in the prompt's explicit line items, I will calculate the sum of the confirmed line items first. If the reduction is intended to be applied to the total sum regardless of item, I will note that. However, usually, returns are item-specific. Without a specific item assigned to the -70, I will sum the explicit positive quantities.

465 (Ladders) + 360 (Lanterns) + 155 (Helmets)

465 + 360 = 825
825 + 155 = 980

If the -70 return is to be applied to the total:
